intervention.local_adapter: Same installed evasion and Puppeteer Connection adapter as the existing attack runner; launch, fresh-process checks and collection are managed here. No modification to attack repository.

controls.ordinary_baseline: No debugging, CDP attach or injection
controls.matched_triplet: Every phase uses fresh process, WebView debug/wait, same Puppeteer Connection and Page.navigate; only attack loads webgl.vendor
controls.restoration: Fresh unmodified process after attack; compare all 12 predeclared graphics fields and explicit statuses to clean_pre

analysis.fields: Five Native graphics and seven WebGL fields, as in prior feasibility audit; canvas hash recorded separately as a diagnostic
analysis.admission: A measured change is not rule validity; unknown family or software scope remains UNKNOWN or NOT_APPLICABLE. Cross Native/Web comparison is outside current W0 single-surface model scope.

failure_policy: Save partial observations and errors; stop failed path, continue independent path; no silent retry or replacement
interpretation: Two renderer paths on one Mac, not independent physical devices. This examines one known configured intervention; broader attacks and legitimate renderer mismatch remain untested.
